text_block_list.name: Karin
text_block_list.text: [3C404EFF]Thank you everyone for your hard work! The item we just obtained seems to be a special hunting certificate that can be obtained by defeating monsters in this area.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさんお疲れ様です！
先ほど獲得したアイテムは、
この周辺の魔物を倒すと手に入る、
特別な討伐証のようですね。

text_block_list.name: Karin
text_block_list.text: [3C404EFF]If you collect them, please bring them to the Guild Management Association and we will exchange them for rewards! Let's exchange them right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
集めて、ギルド管理協会に持ってきていただければ、
報酬と交換させていただきますよ！
さっそく交換してみましょう！
